verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents its own anti-bot options: a `premium_proxy` parameter to "bypass difficult to scrape websites" and a `stealth_proxy` option that runs alongside its headless-browser JS scenarios. However, `stealth_proxy` appears only in a limitation note, and nothing describes it as an undetected or fingerprint-evading browser mode. missing for 10: explicit documentation of an undetected/stealth browser mode, description of what stealth_proxy does against sophisticated bot detection, evidence of success against named anti-bot systems, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use an undetected browser mode to bypass sophisticated bot detection systems

citations.quote: Use premium proxies to bypass difficult to scrape websites
